app_name: Dental Coass Master Dashboard & Clinical Tracker
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully integrated React full-stack application (FastAPI backend + React frontend) for dental coass students. Implement all 7 requested modules: 1) Requirement Tracker with department progress and cross-linked patient lists, 2) Logbook with interactive Odontogram, Media Before/After Comparator, and WhatsApp action, 3) Gemini AI Assistant (Flash/Pro with Emergent LLM key) for Treatment Plan, SOAP Note Generator, and Dental Knowledge Q&A, 4) Calendar, Reminders & Supervisor Log with grading history, 5) Treatment Timeline, Consent/Post-Op Form Generator, and PDF/Excel export, 6) SOP Library, Drug Contraindication Alerts, and Journal Bookmarks, 7) Dental Kit Inventory & Expense Tracker, plus Google Drive OAuth 2.0 integration for syncing records and photos.
universal_guidelines: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
NO universal transitions like transition: all.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) and clear container borders with internal padding.
Ensure all dropdowns, overlays, and headers have solid or backdrop-blur-xl opaque backgrounds, never fully transparent.
Responsive design across mobile and desktop views.
